scripts.generate:bindings: cargo run --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- harness bindings generate
scripts.sync:agents: nx run rhino-cli:build --skip-nx-cache && ./apps/rhino-cli/dist/rhino-cli harness sync opencode --agents-only
scripts.sync:skills: nx run rhino-cli:build --skip-nx-cache && ./apps/rhino-cli/dist/rhino-cli harness sync opencode --skills-only
scripts.sync:dry-run: nx run rhino-cli:build --skip-nx-cache && ./apps/rhino-cli/dist/rhino-cli harness sync opencode --dry-run
scripts.validate:sync: nx run rhino-cli:build --skip-nx-cache && ./apps/rhino-cli/dist/rhino-cli harness sync validate
scripts.validate:harness-bindings: nx run rhino-cli:build --skip-nx-cache && ./apps/rhino-cli/dist/rhino-cli harness bindings validate
scripts.validate:claude: nx run rhino-cli:build --skip-nx-cache && ./apps/rhino-cli/dist/rhino-cli harness claude validate
scripts.validate:config: npm run validate:claude && npm run generate:bindings && npm run validate:opencode

*.md: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md mermaid validate
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md heading-hierarchy validate
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md naming validate
cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- md frontmatter validate
*.{json,toml,ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs,rs,go: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- convention emoji validate
*.feature: cargo run --release --quiet --manifest-path apps/rhino-cli/Cargo.toml -- specs gherkin-cardinality validate
docker-compose*.{yml,yaml}: bash -c 'for f; do docker compose -f "$f" config > /dev/null; done' --
